s4_attain_by_region: SELECT hr_bridge.region, AVG(opportunities.quota_attainment) as avg_attainment FROM opportunities JOIN hr_bridge ON opportunities.employee_id = hr_bridge.employee_id GROUP BY hr_bridge.region
s4_revenue_by_region: SELECT hr_bridge.region, SUM(opportunities.closed_revenue) as total_revenue FROM opportunities JOIN hr_bridge ON opportunities.employee_id = hr_bridge.employee_id GROUP BY hr_bridge.region
s4_attain_advneg: SELECT AVG(opportunities.quota_attainment) as avg_attainment FROM opportunities JOIN rep_course_flags ON opportunities.employee_id = rep_course_flags.employee_id WHERE rep_course_flags.completed_advneg = TRUE
s4_attain_no_advneg: SELECT AVG(opportunities.quota_attainment) as avg_attainment FROM opportunities JOIN rep_course_flags ON opportunities.employee_id = rep_course_flags.employee_id WHERE rep_course_flags.completed_advneg = FALSE
s4_attain_by_advneg: SELECT rep_course_flags.completed_advneg, AVG(opportunities.quota_attainment) as avg_attainment FROM opportunities JOIN rep_course_flags ON opportunities.employee_id = rep_course_flags.employee_id GROUP BY rep_course_flags.completed_advneg
s4_assess_emea: SELECT AVG(assessment_scores.score) as avg_score FROM assessment_scores JOIN learners ON assessment_scores.learner_id = learners.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge ON lower(replace(learners.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(hr_bridge.work_email) WHERE hr_bridge.region = 'EMEA'
s4_attain_emea: SELECT AVG(opportunities.quota_attainment) as avg_attainment FROM opportunities JOIN hr_bridge ON opportunities.employee_id = hr_bridge.employee_id WHERE hr_bridge.region = 'EMEA'
s4_attain_by_distract: SELECT rep_course_flags.completed_distract, AVG(opportunities.quota_attainment) as avg_attainment FROM opportunities JOIN rep_course_flags ON opportunities.employee_id = rep_course_flags.employee_id GROUP BY rep_course_flags.completed_distract
s5_advneg_lift: WITH completed AS (SELECT AVG(opportunities.quota_attainment) as avg_attain FROM opportunities JOIN rep_course_flags ON opportunities.employee_id = rep_course_flags.employee_id WHERE rep_course_flags.completed_advneg = TRUE), not_completed AS (SELECT AVG(opportunities.quota_attainment) as avg_attain FROM opportunities JOIN rep_course_flags ON opportunities.employee_id = rep_course_flags.employee_id WHERE rep_course_flags.completed_advneg = FALSE) SELECT completed.avg_attain - not_completed.avg_attain as lift FROM completed, not_completed
s4_unans_manager: SELECT direct_manager, AVG(opportunities.quota_attainment) as avg_attainment FROM opportunities GROUP BY direct_manager
s4_unans_age: SELECT age_band, AVG(assessment_scores.score) as avg_score FROM assessment_scores GROUP BY age_band
